title: Notifications (Abstract Class)
hints: abstract class Notification { … } can't be created with new, but its subclasses can.
Write send once, in Notification. It calls channel() and format(text), which each subclass writes.
Each subclass constructor passes the recipient up with super(to).

pt-br.title: Notificações (classe abstrata)
hints: abstract class Notification { … } não pode ser criada com new, mas as subclasses dela podem.
Escreva o send uma vez só, em Notification. Ele chama channel() e format(text), que cada subclasse escreve.
O construtor de cada subclasse repassa o destinatário com super(to).
mustContain: Escreva Notification como uma classe abstrata.
Deixe channel() e format() abstratos em Notification.
Email, Sms e Push devem estender Notification.

mustContain.message: Write Notification as an abstract class.
Leave channel() and format() abstract in Notification.
Email, Sms and Push should extend Notification.

tests.input:
3
email ana@example.org Your order has shipped
sms +5511999990000 Your code: 4821
push bia Meeting at 3pm
tests.output:
EMAIL to ana@example.org: Your order has shipped
SMS to +5511999990000: Your code: 4821
PUSH to bia: MEETING AT 3PM
